classification: prospective synthetic development efficacy, NOT protected scientific first-use
question: Can a public action- and stage-conditional causal evidence posterior retrieve appropriate immutable old/native-new memory during continued cumulative Yggdrasil training, beating strong conventional and ablated controls on disjoint A/B/A worlds without interfering with original knowledge?
hypothesis: Stage-conditional evidence of witnessed action consequences can route forecasts between immutable original causal context memory and newly learned native memory; the key must be public-only, and no post-outcome gate updates may affect the current prediction.

design.initial_public_state: exact last witnessed post from previous immutable CAP01 checkpoint; preserve continuity
design.matched_actions: two intervention action bits independently precommitted by seed and index, same tape for all arms; no adaptive policy differences
design.trained_model: cold restore exact CAP01 learned seven-component+native-shard checkpoint; continue 32 genuinely new native witnessed episodes in the existing shard, preserving immutable original pre-CAP01 archive bytes and prior prefix
design.forecast: first stage P(s2) before observing s2 or y; second P(y) after witnessed s2 and announced x2, before observed y; no hidden regime id or future label
design.selector: 3 experts: frozen archive native, cumulative new-shard native, and fully fitted public-history Beta count forecast; the retrieval policy uses only archive vs new-shard, with stage- and context-specific log-likelihood posterior and fixed prior (1/2,1/2). Backoff on insufficient context observations (<4 witnessed same-context stage) to equal fixed 50/50 blend. Fully fitted Beta-full/recent32 and ungated 50/50 are scored controls, not accepted policy.
design.context: transition key is (public paired-view first state bit, first action); terminal key is (first public state bit, first action, witnessed s2, second action). No hidden phase/source family/time or private initial-state inputs.
design.posterior: Prequential evidence update AFTER realized consequence only, via capped probability in [0.05,0.95] and exact Bayesian likelihood of each expert; evidence per keyed context stored as nonnegative 2-component positive products initialized to 1. Posterior weight computed at read using previous evidence. Do not mutate trained weights in selector.
design.negatives: mismatched stage, duplicate source id, forged/cold state, outcome-shuffled posterior, fixed 50/50, full/recent beta, archive-only, segment-only, no-action ablation
design.cold: Persist selector evidence ledger and CAP01 model checkpoints with exact original hash and replay from witnessed public sequence, reject tampered source/outcomes even if rehashed

frozen_outcomes.late: last 10 new first+second stage outcomes, pooled Brier each of 2 separate new-world seeds
frozen_outcomes.success: per-seed gated Brier at least 0.005 lower than BOTH fully fitted Beta full, Beta recent32, ungated 50/50, archived native, active native and shuffled-history sham, plus at least 0.005 Brier gain on old A-return phase vs ungated and Beta full; all evidence and cold source custody PASS
frozen_outcomes.retention: exact immutable old archive checkpoint and old already-consumed readout unchanged BEFORE/AFTER, and full original 1054/1029 episode ledger prefix unchanged after 32 further updates
frozen_outcomes.stop: one paired original source-bound development scoring pass each seed, NO post-result retuning or replay of scored seed as new first-use; if any metric fails classify DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO; no scientific first-use or promotion
